label: TP
reason: User input is sanitized by replacing double quotes with " entities, but this only mitigates a subset of XSS vectors. The data attribute uses single quotes, so unescaped single quotes in user input (e.g., O'Reilly) would still break out of the attribute and inject malicious scripts. The reported path directly embeds unsanitized input into the DOM.

evidence.note: User input is embedded into HTML data attribute without full sanitization
